# Brightfront Studio

> Brightfront Studio is a one-person brand, web and marketing studio in Brisbane, Australia (ABN 80 241 124 181), run by Roxanne Alterio. The work is rebrands and refreshes: tidying up a brand that has fallen behind the business, rebuilding the website around what customers actually do, and then running the marketing that keeps it moving. Clients deal with Roxanne directly from first call to launch. Australian and worldwide.

Tagline: Rebrand. Build. Grow.

## Who it is for

Established small businesses whose branding no longer matches how good the business has become: the logo is years old, the website was built in a hurry, and the marketing is whatever anyone remembered to post that week. Most do not need to start again, they need a tidy-up and someone keeping it moving.

## Services and prices (AUD, including GST for Australian clients)

Prices are a starting point. The real number is fixed in writing before any work starts and does not move unless the client adds to the job. Half to begin, half on the day the site goes live. Monthly work is month to month with no lock-in.

- Strategy session, $350: a 90-minute call covering where the business is, where the owner wants it, and what the marketing has to do to get there, written up as a one-page plan with priorities, order of work and rough costs. The $350 is redeemable against the project if the client goes ahead with the work. A quarterly strategy review is included in the Keep it moving and Keep it growing monthly plans.
- Branding, from $1,200: logo, colours, type, a one-page brand guide, email signatures, social templates, and every print and web file. Supplied ready to use.
- Websites, from $1,500: custom sites built around the one thing the customer came to do. Fast on phones, easy to find on Google, owned by the client.
- App design, from $10,000: app screens, onboarding, app branding, App Store and Google Play listings, launch pages and launch campaigns. Sold as an add-on to a brand or website build, typically $10,000 to $20,000 depending on scope.
- Social media management, from $750 a month: a month of posts designed, written and scheduled from one content day.
- Google and Meta ads, from $600 a month plus ad spend: campaign setup, landing pages, management and monthly reporting.
- Signage, print and billboards, from $450: print-ready artwork for business cards, shopfronts, vehicles, billboards, menus, DL flyers, loyalty and stamp cards, stickers, brochures and packaging, supplied to the client's printer or signwriter.
- Email and automation: enquiry forms, automatic replies, follow-up sequences and a customer list the client owns.
- Care plan, $99 a month: hosting, security, backups and up to 5 changes a month. No lock-in.
- Real estate marketing, quoted to suit: agency websites, expression of interest forms and property e-brochures.

## How it works

1. Discover: a fifteen-minute call about what the business sells, who is buying, and what the marketing is doing now.
2. Shape: a fixed price and a plan in writing, usually within one business day.
3. Build: brand, website and words made by the same person, with a real draft early rather than a wireframe weeks later.
4. Launch: forms tested, tracking on, search engines told, every account in the client's name before handover.
5. Grow: watch what it does, change what is not working, add ads and content when the client is ready.

## What clients own

Everything. Domain, designs, words, photos and ad accounts are all registered in the client's name. If they leave, they take the lot.

## Work

- Alter You (alteryouapp.com), health and fitness: a women's training, nutrition and cycle-tracking app. Brand identity, website design, page design, photography and launch.
